businesses.title: Trelio — Milestone Authorization & Client Portal
businesses.description: Client portal and milestone payment authorization SaaS for creative studios and agencies. Built with authorization-before-execution stage locks, immutable audit ledgers, and multi-tenant billing.

sideProjects.title: Apex Packaging — Industrial CPQ & Estimating Suite
sideProjects.description: Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) software engineered to the exact manufacturing floor specs of an industrial label converter. Features floor-accurate FINAT 1–8 rewind math, substrate yield calculators, and automated PDF job sheets.
